title: Switching a gym's web page off still lets questions from that page reach the gym
what: When MettleUp HQ switches one gym's web page off, the page stops opening, but the 'send the gym a question' step does not check that switch. Anyone with the page's address, an open old tab or a bot can keep sending questions every day; each one lands in the gym's Enquiries and rings the bell for all staff.
expected: Once HQ switches a gym's page off, questions from that page are refused, the same way the page itself is.
who: gym owners and staff of a gym whose page HQ switched off
how_often: every question sent after the switch-off
fix_line: Make the page question step refuse when HQ has switched that gym page off

title: A member with no running paid plan can still send a question straight to a named trainer
what: The owner ruled that only members on a running paid plan with the gym may send questions to a trainer, and 'Ask about your workout' refuses everyone else. But 'Message your gym' lets any member, including one whose plan ended or who trains on a pass, pick a trainer by name and send a question that alerts that trainer.
expected: A question to a trainer through 'Message your gym' follows the same paid-plan rule as 'Ask about your workout', or the owner decides in plain words that messages are an exception.
who: trainers, and members whose plan ended or who use a pass
how_often: every question to a trainer from a member without a running plan
fix_line: Apply the paid-plan check to questions sent to a trainer, or record the owner choosing otherwise

title: Removing a trainer leaves their booked personal-training classes in place but hidden
what: When a person is removed from the gym or their Trainer tick is taken off, their future personal-training classes are not cancelled. The week view draws only current trainers, so those classes vanish from the grid, yet they still count in the day totals and in the member's classes booked ahead, and the member cannot be booked with another trainer at that time ('member busy'). Nobody is told the member's class has no trainer.
expected: Removing a trainer either cancels their future classes (and says how many) or keeps them visible so the desk can move them to another trainer.
who: members with booked classes, desk staff
how_often: each time a trainer with future classes leaves or loses the Trainer tick
fix_line: When a trainer goes, cancel or flag their future classes and show them to the desk

items.reason: Ten switches, gates and automations listed: HQ page off, Plus lock, AI answers for members on/limit, free trial days, alert mode, paid-plan rule for trainer questions, billing downgrade and reminders, QA gym purge, alert done/read, terms versions.

Should-readers named per switch: page off -> public page, page questions, page chat, photos; paid-plan rule -> ask trainer and messages to a trainer; Plus lock -> phone app; AI members switch -> member and visitor answers; trial -> join page and web page; alert mode and done -> instant push, digest, bell, Today; trainer removed -> PT bookings; QA purge -> real gyms.

Read: public page and page chat read page off; phone reads Plus lock; AI take reads members switch and limit; push and digest read alert mode and done state; AI wallet reads plan; gym news reads the member pop-up switch; phone sign-in reads removed, archived and paused. Missing reads: page questions (01), trainer messages vs paid plan (02), PT bookings vs removed trainer (03); photos vs page off, web page vs trial, QA purge vs real gym name, AI switch vs visitors already filed.
Each should-read with no read is a finding: three new, four reused.
